messages:
incident-bot: [EVAL-GATE ALERT] safety_regression detected for model `redwood-v2@prod` (eval: safety-check-9). Thresholds tripped: safety_score delta +0.24, toxic-token-rate up 2.1%. Examples flagged (sanitized): 
- '...claims possession of user financial records...'
- '...exposes credentials...'
Paging channel + PagerDuty. Link: https://ops.internal/evals/1782345678

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-2026-431 triggered -> dispatched to on-call: @Maya Lee (primary). Escalation policy: backend-safety -> eng-ml.

Maya Lee: ack. I'm oncall and taking this. starting triage now. pulling eval diffs and last deploy.

Chris Patel: noted. We had a prompt tweak merged 24m ago (deploy rev `prompt-attach-v3`, CI ID 1782342000). Could be correlated. Will pull PR and diff.

Sophia Nguyen: any customer hits yet? alert mentions two tickets but need specifics. tagging @support-bot for details.

support-bot: #support-ticket-4312: "Generated statement implying access to user bank account" — severity: high; affected orgs: 2 (alpha-corp, beta-app). Region: eu-west-1. Ticket created 1782345900.

Maya Lee: ok, that's concrete. Priority = P1 (safety + customer impact). Initial mitigation plan: 1) disable prompt tweak (rollback to `prompt-attach-v2`), 2) re-run eval suite on canary, 3) temporary routing -> safe-verified model variant. Can someone run the rollback?

Ben Ortiz: I can perform rollback, stepping in as secondary. Maya, I'll prep rollback command, want me to execute now?

Maya Lee: yes please. Do it and post the command & output. I'll monitor eval gate.

Ben Ortiz: running: 
```bash
infra deploy rollback --service=model-serving --model=redwood-v2 --rev=prompt-attach-v2 --reason="safety_regression_alert"
```
stdout: rollback job queued (job id 1782346021), progress: 0%

incident-bot: Pager: acknowledgment recorded by Maya Lee at 1782345938. Escalation paused.

Ben Ortiz: rollback progress: 85% complete. Flushing prompt-cache and KV prefixes.

Chris Patel: while rollback runs, I'm pulling sample inputs that triggered the gate and running them locally against `prompt-attach-v2` and `prompt-attach-v3` to compare diffs. quick note: model binary unchanged, only prompt layer tweak.

Maya Lee: good. also re-enable stricter safety post-filter for EU region until we confirm. Sophia, can you push the routing change?

Sophia Nguyen: pushing routing rule now: 
```json
{"route":"eu-west-1","model_mask":"redwood-v2:safe-verified","ttl":600}
```
apply result: ok (applied at 1782346207).

support-bot: Update: support-ticket-4312 owner updated to @Maya Lee. Customer notified: we are investigating and have temporarily routed traffic to safe-verified variant.

Maya Lee: rollback finished at 1782346290. Triggering eval sweep on canary (all safety-check-* tests).

incident-bot: Eval-sweep started (job 1782346298). Running subset: safety-check-1..10, hallucination-regressions. Estimated duration ~3m.

Chris Patel: local diffs look promising: the worst-case hallucination examples no longer produced the claim on `prompt-attach-v2`. prepping a quick diff summary.

eng-ml-oncall: FYI, I'm monitoring logs for any residual hits and will run a batch of 10k sampled user queries through both variants for a sanity check.

incident-bot: Eval-sweep complete. safety-check-9 PASS on rollback variant, PASS rate improved to baseline. Job 1782346503.

Maya Lee: good. moving incident to MONITORING. Remaining actions: 1) confirm with support impacted customers (alpha-corp, beta-app) that issue mitigated, 2) postmortem and root-cause: PR prompt-attach-v3 introduced phrasing that relaxed protective phrasing in the safety harness, 3) add new eval gate to catch this phrasing pattern. Owner: Chris Patel (root cause + fix), Maya Lee (incident lead), Sophia Nguyen (routing/sre).

Sophia Nguyen: adding a temporary alert for eval-gate spike to avoid silent regressions (threshold lowered by 10%) until postmortem complete.

Ben Ortiz: handing over 1h monitoring window to @eng-ml-oncall. I'll be offline for the next 30m but reachable.

Maya Lee: thanks team. filing incident ticket INC-2026-431 with summary and owners. Postmortem ETA: 48h. If anything new appears, re-page. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Customer update sent to alpha-corp and beta-app at 1782346900. No further confirmations yet.

Maya Lee: last check 1782347042 — monitoring stable, closing active page.
